title: Sensor reading
description: Published by a device on smart-gardening/{device_id}/readings. A sensor that fails to read is sent as null.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bumped on any breaking change.

device_id.description: Device (IoT thing) name. The device_id in the topic takes precedence over this field.

ts.description: When the reading was taken, UTC.

soil_moisture_raw.description: Uncalibrated ADC value of the soil moisture sensor (12 bits). Key is mandatory; null if the sensor failed.

soil_moisture.description: Calibrated soil moisture in %. Only sent when the sensor is calibrated.

light.description: Light level in % of the sensor range.

zone.description: Irrigation zone key (one valve per zone).

utc_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC, with a trailing Z.
